Name: Seasonal outfits for Aideen
Author: medicsun
Description:
[size=3][i]This is not a replacement mod, it works standalone outside of East Scarp. Place into mod folder[/i]

I also recommend checking out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10731?tab=posts]Tyrenoth's Aideen portraits[/url], she has a much more doll look and actual victorian-looking outfits! Matching sprites are in the mods comments/posts.
CHECK OUT POLTERGEISTER'S SEASONAL EAST SCARP TOO!!! ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16045]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16045[/url])
She looks much closer to the original drawing :)

[/size]Seasonal outfits for [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url]'s lovely florist Aideen.

Downloads.Description:
New Outfits:
Optional alt Fall & Beach
Spirits Eve
Moonlight Jellies/Luau
Sleepwear (when married)

Small adjustments to various outfits

Config option to remove hand from face
Removed option for Vanilla Style Flower Dance

See Changelog for Details
